user_problem: Data teams need to distinguish exact duplicates from probable matches before choosing remediation.
unique_output: A duplicate triage report separating exact, normalized, candidate, and non-match groups with stated comparison rules.
test_case: Classify a fixture containing exact copies, case differences, shared names with different IDs, and incomplete rows.
overlap_to_check: Entity resolution products and join-cardinality audits.
specific_guardrail: Explicit user comparison rules only. Preserve record IDs and conflicts; do not auto-merge, identify people, choose winners or treat normalization as identity proof.
